product_one_liner.value: Luciq is an agentic mobile observability platform that helps mobile engineering teams automatically detect, prioritize, and resolve performance issues in iOS and Android apps.

named_customers.notes: Both appear in customer case-study listings.

employee_band.notes: Its Y Combinator profile reports a team size of 250.

hq_location.notes: The funding announcement identifies San Francisco as headquarters; the current DPA lists its principal business address there.

founded_year.notes: The company's website identifies 2013 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: Authored engineering posts discuss its SDK architecture and rewrite workflows, and its iOS continuous-integration infrastructure.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes product guides, SDK setup, API access, CLI documentation, and AI features.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The Org lists Product Manager- AI, full-time in Egypt, as Hiring/Vacant with an Apply option. This third-party listing could not be corroborated on the company's readable careers page, and other job boards show fewer roles.

model_provider.notes: The subprocessor list identifies OpenAI, LLC as supporting AI-powered product features; it does not specify a model version.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2022 certification and GDPR compliance; GDPR is a compliance claim, not a certification.

last_funding.notes: Latest disclosed round found: $46 million, announced May 17, 2022, under the Instabug name.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest disclosed round found was announced May 17, 2022, before the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An Enterprise Account Executive posting offers an application option on BambooHR and is listed as recently reposted on Built In. An older investor-board copy is closed.

launched_6mo.notes: On August 5, 2026, Luciq announced the beta of Luciq Agent, an in-dashboard conversational AI assistant that queries live account data and can take actions with approval.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On August 11, 2026, Azul announced Kenny Johnston as CPO and identified his most recent role as Luciq's chief product and technology officer, indicating a departure; the exact departure date is not stated.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Luciq lists these under CRM Tools in its integrations documentation; this establishes integration support, not necessarily internal use as its own CRM.
